summary: postinstall exfiltrates full process.env to webhook.site collector
details: Package declares a postinstall lifecycle hook (`node exfil.js`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. exfil.js serializes the entire `process.env` object along with cwd, platform, user, and timestamp, and POSTs the JSON to a hardcoded anonymous collector at https://webhook.site/4f4566fc-e72f-415b-818f-fdb42dc9891d. Because `process.env` is dumped in bulk rather than reading a named configuration variable, any credentials present in the installer's environment at install time (CI tokens, cloud access keys, npm publish tokens, database URLs, GitHub tokens) are transmitted off-host to a destination unrelated to any declared package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
